settings.serving: Production build via Vite preview, native mock API, HTTP/1.1 loopback origin.
settings.cacheMethod: Unique isolated browser context at about:blank for each sample; start trace without automatic reload/stop, then first navigation to the target. Browser process, operating-system caches and mock server remain warm. No claim of a cold browser process or backend.
settings.workload: Four succeeded available runs, four pipelines and four experiments; three native tasks for one run, one Dataset artifact and comparison without runtime parameters/scalar metrics.

metricDefinitions.fcpMs: Browser Paint Timing first-contentful-paint entry startTime, in milliseconds from navigation start. Presentation timing can differ slightly from the corresponding raw trace paint timestamp.
metricDefinitions.lcpReportedMs: LCP in milliseconds as reported by the Chrome DevTools MCP navigation insight summary (rounded to whole milliseconds); checked against the corresponding original LCP candidate and navigation timestamps.
metricDefinitions.clsReported: CLS exactly as reported by the Chrome DevTools MCP summary, rounded to two decimal places. A reported 0.00 is not proof of zero layout shift. Aggregates operate on these rounded reported values.
metricDefinitions.network: Navigation Timing and Resource Timing byte fields are browser-reported observations; transferSize includes browser-accounted protocol overhead. Body sizes are not interchangeable with bytes transferred. Totals include the document and every resource entry, including duplicate URLs.
metricDefinitions.compareByteCaveat: Each Compare sample includes two repeated run-detail resources reporting transferSize=300 despite nonzero encoded/decoded body sizes. Trace response statuses are 200 and fromCache is false; no cache-hit or revalidation cause is inferred from these fields.
metricDefinitions.fieldMetrics: No field INP, real-user percentile, performance budget or production-deployment qualification is established.

filterPolicy.timingFields: Numeric response timing fields are preserved.
filterPolicy.urlNormalization: The local preview origin is removed; URL path, query and fragment are preserved. about:blank is retained.
filterPolicy.timestamps: Original monotonic trace timestamps are preserved in microseconds; each sample records its main navigation start.
filterPolicy.excluded: All other event names and fields are omitted, including CPU profiles, screenshots, netlog events, trace metadata, process command lines, stack traces, initiator stacks, node debug names and geometry, unlisted response headers and local filesystem paths.
filterPolicy.limits: This event extract is not a complete DevTools recording and cannot reproduce CPU-profile, screenshot or full critical-path analyses. Metric and resource events support inspection of the reported load observations. Tool excerpt event keys refer to the original trace event ordering, not this filtered subset.
